howItAffectsYourReach: Applies the final top-k truncation, dropping all candidates that fall outside the target feed capacity.
theGoldenRule: Your post must outscore competing candidates to survive top-k selection into the final response payload.

inSimpleTerms: This file acts as a non-mutating selector that passes candidates forward without altering order or truncating. It is used in transparent pipeline stages.
whyThisExists: Provides a clean passthrough component for pipelines where candidate ordering and sizing is handled upstream or downstream.
howItAffectsYourReach: Preserves candidate ranking order exactly as output by the preceding scorer stage.
theGoldenRule: Ensure your content achieves high upstream scores, as passthrough stages will not alter previous rankings.

inSimpleTerms: This file sorts scored candidates in descending order and selects the top-K highest scoring posts. It trims the candidate pool to the final target size.
whyThisExists: Extracts the exact number of top-performing posts needed to fill the user's timeline response page.
howItAffectsYourReach: Hard ranking cutoff: only candidates in the top-K score tier make it to the client response; lower-scoring posts are dropped.
theGoldenRule: Maximize every engagement probability to secure a top-K score ranking among hundreds of competing candidates.

inSimpleTerms: This file acts as the primary gRPC entry point and lifecycle orchestrator for the Home Mixer service. It binds gRPC endpoints, registers telemetry and stats handlers, and dispatches incoming user feed requests to specific pipeline servers.
whyThisExists: X engineers needed a robust microservice bootstrap layer to manage service discovery, thread pools, health checks, and incoming request routing across multiple feed variants.
howItAffectsYourReach: It does not apply direct scoring weights; instead, it enforces timeout budgets and operational uptime, ensuring requests successfully reach candidate retrieval and ranking pipelines.
theGoldenRule: Maintain high-integrity content to pass global service health checks without triggering rate limits or gateway drops.

inSimpleTerms: This file logs the exact insertion points, gap distances, and metadata of ads blended into the organic timeline. It tracks ad-to-organic blending metrics.
whyThisExists: Provides telemetry to verify that ad insertion algorithms adhere to strict distance rules and monetization targets.
howItAffectsYourReach: Monitors organic-to-ad slot ratios, ensuring organic creators maintain their allocated share of the timeline.
theGoldenRule: Produce compelling content that retains viewer attention across ad breaks in the timeline.

inSimpleTerms: This file emits real-time metrics on how frequently individual authors are being served across the platform. It tracks creator impression distribution.
whyThisExists: Allows system monitoring for creator exposure balance, author fatigue detection, and anomalous spam activity.
howItAffectsYourReach: Supplies metrics that can trigger author fatigue limits if an account is over-served within a short time window.
theGoldenRule: Maintain high quality across all posts rather than overwhelming the platform with spammy, high-volume publishing.

inSimpleTerms: This file streams timeline UI rendering events and client interaction logs to Kafka. It captures client-side rendering verification.
whyThisExists: Provides telemetry to verify that served posts were successfully rendered and made visible on the client app.
howItAffectsYourReach: Validates actual visual impressions, which count toward verified impression analytics and model training datasets.
theGoldenRule: Craft engaging content that compels users to pause and read, ensuring verified viewport dwell time.

inSimpleTerms: This file logs detailed candidate attributes and pipeline execution traces for internal debug queries. It provides developer observability.
whyThisExists: Allows X engineers to inspect why specific posts were dropped, filtered, or boosted during internal test sessions.
howItAffectsYourReach: Only active during internal developer debugging sessions; no effect on production creator distribution.
theGoldenRule: Algorithms enforce strict objective rules that can be inspected down to individual scoring feature components.

inSimpleTerms: Module declaration aggregating all asynchronous side-effects, telemetry emitters, Kafka publishers, and cache writers.
whyThisExists: Decouples post-response background logging, impression tracking, and caching from the critical request path.
howItAffectsYourReach: Records served post IDs and interaction telemetry to Kafka, feeding real-time training datasets and deduplication caches.
theGoldenRule: Every served impression is tracked asynchronously to update freshness models and prevent repetitive impressions.

inSimpleTerms: This file records analytics on the proportion of mutual-follow interactions occurring in served feeds. It tracks social graph density metrics.
whyThisExists: Monitors platform health regarding community connectivity and mutual relationship engagement in the feed.
howItAffectsYourReach: Provides telemetry used by engineers to calibrate mutual-follow ranking multipliers.
theGoldenRule: Develop authentic, two-way creator relationships to benefit from mutual-graph algorithmic weighting.

inSimpleTerms: This file logs experimental variant allocations and scoring telemetry for Phoenix A/B test groups. It tracks ML model experiment performance.
whyThisExists: Enables machine learning engineers to evaluate new neural architectures and scoring loss functions against live production baselines.
howItAffectsYourReach: Allocates candidate scoring across experiment variants, testing different weightings for engagement types.
theGoldenRule: Deliver balanced engagement across likes, retweets, and comments to succeed across diverse ML model experiment buckets.

inSimpleTerms: This file caches Phoenix neural scoring request tensors and intermediate predictions. It prevents redundant model evaluations for identical query contexts.
whyThisExists: Saves expensive GPU inference compute by caching neural scoring outputs across short-lived request bursts.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures consistent scoring across rapid pagination requests while optimizing platform inference efficiency.
theGoldenRule: Consistent high-quality content maintains stable score representations in recommendation caches.

inSimpleTerms: This file publishes the IDs of posts that reached the user's viewport to Kafka impression topics. It logs definitive post impressions.
whyThisExists: Updates distributed real-time impression stores so that seen posts can be filtered out across all devices.
howItAffectsYourReach: Marks your post as seen, updating impression bloom filters across all user client instances.
theGoldenRule: Maximize initial visual hook appeal to convert every logged impression into active engagement.

inSimpleTerms: This file writes hydrated and scored post candidates into a fast Redis cache. It enables quick candidate retrieval for subsequent pagination queries.
whyThisExists: Improves pagination latency and reduces computational load by caching high-value candidates for rapid subsequent fetching.
howItAffectsYourReach: Extends the reach window of high-scoring posts by making them readily available for subsequent feed page loads.
theGoldenRule: High initial post scores keep your content hot in distributed Redis candidate caches.

inSimpleTerms: This file logs pre- and post-reranking candidate orders and features to Kafka. It tracks how rerankers modify candidate positions.
whyThisExists: Used for offline model training and debug analysis to evaluate the exact impact of reranking heuristics on final output.
howItAffectsYourReach: Captures training data that teaches reranking algorithms how to optimize final list ordering.
theGoldenRule: Create content that drives deep discussion to stay favored by downstream reranking models.

inSimpleTerms: This file records global response statistics, latency percentiles, and candidate count metrics. It monitors overall service performance.
whyThisExists: Essential for operational site reliability, alerting engineers to latency spikes, drops in candidate counts, or service degradations.
howItAffectsYourReach: Maintains service availability, ensuring creator posts are served reliably within strict response deadlines.
theGoldenRule: Standard system uptime guarantees your content reaches active users without pipeline dropouts.

inSimpleTerms: This file aggregates and logs distributions of candidate scores (min, max, median, standard deviation). It monitors model scoring health.
whyThisExists: Detects model drift, score compression, or anomalous feature inputs across production scoring pipelines.
howItAffectsYourReach: Helps maintain calibrated score distributions across all creators and content categories.
theGoldenRule: Consistently high engagement places your posts in the upper percentiles of the logged score distribution.

inSimpleTerms: This file records served advertisements in the user's ad history cache. It prevents repetitive ad displays.
whyThisExists: Maintains ad frequency caps and ensures compliance with commercial spacing policies.
howItAffectsYourReach: Regulates commercial ad spacing, preserving the organic post slots surrounding ad units.
theGoldenRule: High-quality organic content thrives in the dedicated organic slots preserved between ad placements.

inSimpleTerms: This file publishes the list of served post candidates to Kafka event streams asynchronously after a response is sent. It records what was delivered to the user.
whyThisExists: Provides essential training logs and telemetry to downstream analytics, impression trackers, and ML model training pipelines.
howItAffectsYourReach: Serves as the ground-truth logging mechanism that powers impression counting and positive/negative training labels for future ranking models.
theGoldenRule: Generating positive user actions when served ensures your impression logs train future models to favor your content.

inSimpleTerms: This file prunes and truncates the user's served history cache to maintain bounded size limits. It discards expired history entries.
whyThisExists: Prevents infinite storage growth and ensures impression history lookups remain fast and memory-efficient.
howItAffectsYourReach: Allows older posts to eventually exit the impression suppression window after a long passage of time.
theGoldenRule: Focus on publishing new content rather than expecting historical posts to re-enter user impression cycles.

inSimpleTerms: This file logs the timestamp of each timeline request to track user session frequency and inter-request intervals. It updates user activity telemetry.
whyThisExists: Used to compute session gap features and adjust freshness weighting based on how frequently a user opens the app.
howItAffectsYourReach: Users who open the app frequently receive fresher, lower-latency content batches, increasing opportunities for new posts to be served.
theGoldenRule: Post consistently throughout the day to reach active users across their multiple daily session intervals.

inSimpleTerms: This file writes served post IDs into the user's persistent served history cache (e.g., Manhattan or Redis). It records recently served content.
whyThisExists: Enables deduplication filters to prevent the same posts from being served repeatedly on subsequent timeline refreshes.
howItAffectsYourReach: Registers your post as served, meaning the viewing user will not be served this exact post again on their next refresh.
theGoldenRule: Make your post impactful on first view; you will not get repeat impressions on the same user in their primary discovery feed.

inSimpleTerms: This file requests and retrieves targeted sponsored ad candidates from the Ad Server. It injects commercial inventory into candidate streams.
whyThisExists: Connects the organic timeline pipeline with the monetization ad engine for coordinated ad placement.
howItAffectsYourReach: Governs paid distribution reach for promoted campaign posts according to advertiser bids and targeting.
theGoldenRule: Pair organic reach strategies with targeted Promoted Post campaigns for accelerated distribution.

inSimpleTerms: This file pulls post candidates from Redis/memcached fallback caches during backend degradation. It guarantees feed availability under heavy load.
whyThisExists: Provides fault tolerance, ensuring users receive a valid timeline even when primary retrieval microservices experience outages.
howItAffectsYourReach: Resurfaces high-scoring cached posts when primary upstream sources are unreachable.
theGoldenRule: Evergreen content with durable engagement scores remains resilient during backend failover states.

inSimpleTerms: This file injects user satisfaction surveys and feedback prompts into candidate streams. It samples users to gather qualitative feed sentiment.
whyThisExists: Provides ground-truth training signals and customer satisfaction metrics to evaluate algorithm quality.
howItAffectsYourReach: Does not rank posts directly, but user responses to surveys guide long-term model weight adjustments.
theGoldenRule: Create high-satisfaction content that users would rate positively if prompted by platform quality surveys.

inSimpleTerms: This file fetches in-network posts from followed accounts using the Night Owl low-latency index. It retrieves the latest posts from a user's follow graph.
whyThisExists: Provides high-speed in-network candidate retrieval to assemble the base pool of followed tweets for ranking.
howItAffectsYourReach: Direct retrieval path for your followers' feeds; ensures your posts enter your followers' initial candidate pools.
theGoldenRule: Publish consistently so your posts are present in Night Owl in-network retrieval queries for all active followers.

inSimpleTerms: This file retrieves structured promotional and dynamic content frames from the Jetfuel marketing and campaign engine. It sources dynamic informational modules.
whyThisExists: Engineers built this to inject dynamic product announcements, event banners, and special campaign frames into the timeline.
howItAffectsYourReach: Does not affect organic post reach; manages promotional and informational frame inventory.
theGoldenRule: Participate in major platform events and trends that align with active platform campaign frames.

inSimpleTerms: Module declaration grouping all candidate retrieval sources (Phoenix, SimClusters, Thunder, In-Network, Ads, Prompts).
whyThisExists: Defines the source interfaces that query distributed indexing backends to gather thousands of candidate posts per request.
howItAffectsYourReach: Acts as the initial funnel for all content; your post must be retrieved by at least one source to enter recommendation scoring.
theGoldenRule: Publish content with high cluster affinity and follower engagement to be retrieved across multiple candidate sources.

inSimpleTerms: This file retrieves candidate posts from the Phoenix Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) neural model. It queries specialized expert subnetworks trained on diverse user behavior modalities.
whyThisExists: Provides high-capacity, multi-domain recommendation retrieval by routing queries through specialized neural expert networks.
howItAffectsYourReach: Enables niche posts to match with highly targeted user sub-segments through specialized expert routing.
theGoldenRule: Produce specialized, high-depth content; MoE routing connects targeted subject matter with passionate sub-communities.

inSimpleTerms: This file retrieves out-of-network post candidates directly from the Phoenix neural retrieval system. It queries deep neural vector search indexes based on user engagement embeddings.
whyThisExists: Serves as the primary modern discovery engine for surfacing personalized out-of-network content at massive scale.
howItAffectsYourReach: Primary vehicle for algorithmic virality; matches post embeddings to user interest spaces for massive out-of-network reach.
theGoldenRule: Create high-engagement content with strong semantic focus to be indexed into Phoenix neural retrieval clusters.

inSimpleTerms: This file fetches candidate posts from Phoenix topic-based retrieval indexes. It sources top-scoring content associated with specific topic entities.
whyThisExists: Enables the algorithm to inject high-quality topical content matching explicit or inferred user topic interests.
howItAffectsYourReach: Surfaces your posts to users who follow or engage with the topical themes assigned to your content.
theGoldenRule: Structure posts around clear topic themes to qualify for topic-based neural candidate retrieval.

inSimpleTerms: This file retrieves trending and popular topic modules along with their associated top posts. It powers topic discovery units in home feeds.
whyThisExists: Built to highlight broadly trending subjects and introduce users to emerging popular conversations.
howItAffectsYourReach: Top posts in trending topics receive exponential distribution through dedicated topic carousel modules.
theGoldenRule: Contribute authoritative insights early to emerging trending topics to win placement in topic discovery shelves.

inSimpleTerms: This file retrieves system prompts, onboarding nudges, and engagement banners for the timeline. It manages UI prompt insertion.
whyThisExists: Allows the platform to present interactive prompts (e.g., follow suggestions, feature announcements) to users.
howItAffectsYourReach: Manages system UI cards; does not directly score organic creator posts.
theGoldenRule: Stay informed on platform features highlighted in system prompts to adapt your content format.

inSimpleTerms: This file retrieves candidate posts that were targeted for high-priority push notifications and ensures they are available in the home stream. It coordinates notification-to-feed transitions.
whyThisExists: Ensures seamless continuity when a user opens the app after receiving a notification about a specific post.
howItAffectsYourReach: Guarantees top placement for posts that triggered successful high-engagement push notifications.
theGoldenRule: High-priority, breaking content that triggers system push alerts achieves guaranteed home feed delivery.

inSimpleTerms: This file queries the core timeline storage layer for in-network posts ordered strictly by timestamp. It powers the chronological Following tab.
whyThisExists: Delivers a pure reverse-chronological stream of followed content with minimal processing overhead.
howItAffectsYourReach: Provides 100% unranked chronological reach to followers who view the chronological Following tab.
theGoldenRule: Post when your followers are most active to appear at the top of their reverse-chronological feed.

inSimpleTerms: This file fetches candidate posts from upstream pre-scoring services and caching layers. It ingests pre-computed candidate pools for fast timeline assembly.
whyThisExists: Reduces timeline generation latency by reusing pre-scored candidate caches for active users.
howItAffectsYourReach: Allows high-scoring posts to persist across candidate caches, providing sustained impressions across user sessions.
theGoldenRule: Sustain consistent engagement to keep your posts active in upstream pre-scored candidate caches.

inSimpleTerms: This file provides seed candidates for warm-up requests, debugging, and synthetic testing pipelines. It injects deterministic post sets.
whyThisExists: Used by engineers to validate pipeline health, verify filter behavior, and benchmark scoring modules under controlled conditions.
howItAffectsYourReach: Used for internal synthetic testing and diagnostics; no impact on production creator reach.
theGoldenRule: Standard algorithmic performance in production pipelines dictates organic audience growth.

inSimpleTerms: This file retrieves candidate posts using SimClusters community graph embeddings. It discovers content popular within overlapping interest communities and follower clusters.
whyThisExists: Enables interest-based collaborative filtering by discovering posts favored by users who share similar follow-graph clusters.
howItAffectsYourReach: Major source of out-of-network discovery; distributes posts across broader community clusters if influential cluster members engage.
theGoldenRule: Win over influential creators in your niche; their engagement spreads your posts across their entire SimCluster community.

inSimpleTerms: This file interfaces with the Thunder real-time candidate generation engine. It retrieves fresh, viral, and fast-breaking content with high early engagement velocity.
whyThisExists: Built to capture breaking news and real-time viral trends faster than batch embedding pipelines can index.
howItAffectsYourReach: Provides an immediate distribution surge for posts exhibiting explosive early engagement within minutes of posting.
theGoldenRule: Drive immediate, rapid community engagement upon publishing to trigger Thunder real-time retrieval indexing.

inSimpleTerms: This file interfaces with legacy TweetMixer services to fetch candidate pools. It acts as an integration bridge to older candidate generation clusters.
whyThisExists: Maintains backwards compatibility and redundancy with existing candidate retrieval infrastructure.
howItAffectsYourReach: Provides secondary candidate retrieval pathways for in-network and extended-network posts.
theGoldenRule: Maintain strong engagement across all post types to ensure qualification across legacy and modern retrieval sources alike.

inSimpleTerms: This file fetches 'Who To Follow' account recommendation modules from the user graph service. It injects creator recommendation carousels into the feed.
whyThisExists: Drives user network expansion by recommending relevant creators to follow directly inside the home timeline.
howItAffectsYourReach: Surfaces your entire account profile to potential new followers in Who-To-Follow modules.
theGoldenRule: Optimize your profile bio, niche authority, and follow graph to be recommended in Who-To-Follow carousels.

inSimpleTerms: This file encapsulates author-level business rules, frequency caps, and fatigue penalties. It limits how many posts from a single author can appear consecutively.
whyThisExists: Prevents a single prolific creator from monopolizing a user's feed, ensuring creator diversity across the timeline.
howItAffectsYourReach: Applies progressive score demotions to subsequent posts from the same author in a single timeline view.
theGoldenRule: Space out your content throughout the day so each post enters separate user feed generation cycles.

inSimpleTerms: This file contains helper utilities for candidate post manipulation, extraction, sorting, and feature mapping. It provides shared data transformations.
whyThisExists: Eliminates code duplication by standardizing common candidate operations across hydrators, scorers, and filters.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures candidate feature values are correctly formatted and normalized for ML model consumption.
theGoldenRule: Well-formatted posts with valid media and text allow all scoring features to be extracted seamlessly.

inSimpleTerms: This file groups related posts and replies into cohesive conversation trees and modules. It structures discussion threads for timeline rendering.
whyThisExists: Allows the recommendation algorithm to serve organized conversation modules (root tweet + top reply) rather than disjointed individual tweets.
howItAffectsYourReach: High-scoring replies can be bundled directly under popular root tweets in conversation modules, gaining secondary exposure.
theGoldenRule: Post thoughtful, high-value replies to viral tweets to be featured in prime conversation display modules.

inSimpleTerms: This file provides ISO country code parsing and localization mapping utilities. It maps client IP addresses and user profiles to geographic regions.
whyThisExists: Enables region-specific filtering, local trend identification, and geographic content suitability rules.
howItAffectsYourReach: Helps route content to relevant geographic audiences and ensures compliance with country-specific regulations.
theGoldenRule: Tailor content to regional interests and cultural context to maximize engagement in target geographic markets.

inSimpleTerms: This file handles response egress formatting, error translation, and final status code mapping. It prepares responses for gRPC network transmission.
whyThisExists: Standardizes egress response envelopes and manages graceful degradation when upstream errors occur.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures valid timeline payloads reach the user device even if non-critical components experience partial errors.
theGoldenRule: Reliable system delivery ensures that user engagement is smoothly logged and processed platform-wide.

inSimpleTerms: This file formats structured debug and audit logs during feed generation. It records pipeline step execution and candidate tracking details.
whyThisExists: Assists engineers in tracing candidate lifecycle decisions and diagnosing unexpected scoring anomalies.
howItAffectsYourReach: Provides system traceability; no direct influence on algorithmic score calculations.
theGoldenRule: Algorithmic selection is completely auditable and follows rigorous deterministic ranking logic.

inSimpleTerms: Module declaration exporting shared utilities for URT marshalling, shadow execution, logging, and metrics.
whyThisExists: Centralizes helper logic, formatting tools, and RPC marshallers used throughout Home Mixer.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures candidates and responses are correctly transformed, sanitized, and marshalled for client consumption.
theGoldenRule: Robust serialization and data formatting ensure error-free candidate processing across all pipeline stages.

inSimpleTerms: This file formats and constructs gRPC request payloads for the Phoenix neural ranking service. It serializes candidate and query feature tensors.
whyThisExists: Standardizes feature marshalling and serialization required to communicate with deep learning inference backends.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures all user interaction history and post engagement signals are properly transmitted to the neural ranker.
theGoldenRule: Drive strong engagement signals that translate into high feature values in the neural request vector.

inSimpleTerms: This file provides utility functions to apply real-time mathematical modifiers, multipliers, and penalties to post scores. It adjusts composite scores dynamically.
whyThisExists: Centralizes rescoring logic, such as author diversity demotions, freshness decay curves, and media boost multipliers.
howItAffectsYourReach: Applies score multipliers (e.g., reducing an author's second post by 0.5x, boosting rich media posts) directly modifying final rank.
theGoldenRule: Avoid publishing multiple posts at the exact same minute to prevent author fatigue rescore penalties.

inSimpleTerms: This file manages dark-traffic and shadow-mode pipeline execution for testing new algorithm versions. It duplicates live traffic to test systems without affecting users.
whyThisExists: Allows engineers to benchmark new models and pipeline code under live production load without impacting end-user experience.
howItAffectsYourReach: Shadow pipeline results are discarded; only the active production pipeline determines live user reach.
theGoldenRule: Keep an eye on platform algorithm announcements as successful shadow tests eventually become active production rules.

inSimpleTerms: This file provides string normalization and case-conversion utilities for keyword matching and entity parsing. It standardizes text tokens.
whyThisExists: Ensures case-insensitive consistency across muted keyword filters, entity taggers, and text search utilities.
howItAffectsYourReach: Prevents evasion of muted keyword filters through casing tricks (e.g., #Crypto vs #crypto are matched identically).
theGoldenRule: Do not attempt casing gimmicks to bypass keyword filters; maintain honest, high-value copywriting.

inSimpleTerms: This file classifies and calculates metrics across different post formats (original, reply, quote, video, image). It aggregates format-specific telemetry.
whyThisExists: Allows system monitoring to evaluate the performance and distribution ratios of different content formats.
howItAffectsYourReach: Helps engineers tune format-specific multipliers (such as video engagement weights vs text engagement weights).
theGoldenRule: Diversify your content formats (video, threads, images) to benefit across all rewarded post types.

inSimpleTerms: This file provides URL parsing, domain extraction, and link sanitization utilities. It processes external web links attached to posts.
whyThisExists: Allows safety models and brand suitability hydrators to evaluate the reputation and safety of linked external domains.
howItAffectsYourReach: Links to low-reputation, spammy, or unsafe domains can trigger reach penalties or safety filter drops.
theGoldenRule: Link only to reputable, authoritative websites to maintain high trust and avoid link-penalty demotions.

inSimpleTerms: Marshals sponsored ad candidates into Universal Response Timeline (URT) Thrift protocol entries for client display.
whyThisExists: Transforms internal ad candidate representations into client-compliant Thrift structures with tracking tokens and disclosure metadata.
howItAffectsYourReach: Formats ad items for seamless interleaving with organic post entries in the final response payload.
theGoldenRule: Organic posts that share feeds with well-marshalled ads benefit from standard timeline spacing and layout clarity.

inSimpleTerms: Generates client event logging metadata, impression tokens, and telemetry tags attached to timeline entries.
whyThisExists: Enables the mobile and web clients to report accurate scroll, impression, and click events back to analytics servers.
howItAffectsYourReach: Client telemetry feeds back into engagement models, updating author reputation and post performance in real time.
theGoldenRule: Encourage active user interaction; client telemetry reports every click, dwell, and share directly to ranking feedback loops.

inSimpleTerms: Encodes feed controller metadata, experiment bucket IDs, and ranking debug markers into URT responses.
whyThisExists: Provides diagnostic and telemetry tracing info so client and server logs can correlate user experience with specific pipeline configurations.
howItAffectsYourReach: Facilitates real-time A/B testing, evaluating how different ranking parameter variants impact creator reach.
theGoldenRule: Algorithm experiments constantly test parameter tweaks; consistently engaging content thrives across all test buckets.

inSimpleTerms: Marshals conversation threads and reply chains into structured URT Conversation Modules for timeline rendering.
whyThisExists: Formats parent-child reply hierarchies into visually connected conversation units on mobile and web clients.
howItAffectsYourReach: Packages high-ranking replies alongside root posts, turning strong discussions into prominent multi-item feed units.
theGoldenRule: Write compelling replies to high-visibility posts to get packaged into high-ranking conversation modules.

inSimpleTerms: Generates top, bottom, and gap pagination cursors for the For You and algorithmic feeds.
whyThisExists: Manages stateful pagination, enabling smooth infinite scroll and pull-to-refresh without skipping or repeating content.
howItAffectsYourReach: Controls the boundary timestamps and candidate offsets used when fetching the next page of recommended content.
theGoldenRule: Ensure your content sustains steady engagement so it continues ranking well across subsequent pagination cursor requests.

inSimpleTerms: Marshals user satisfaction surveys and feedback prompts into timeline entries.
whyThisExists: Enables the platform to collect explicit qualitative feedback from users regarding feed relevance and content quality.
howItAffectsYourReach: User responses to feed surveys directly calibrate platform-wide ML ranking weights and quality thresholds.
theGoldenRule: Deliver high-value, satisfying content that encourages users to rate their timeline experience positively.

inSimpleTerms: Builds 'See less often', 'Not interested in this topic', and author mute feedback action items for timeline posts.
whyThisExists: Provides the UI action menus allowing users to provide negative feedback and tune their algorithmic preferences.
howItAffectsYourReach: Negative feedback actions immediately penalize author and topic affinity scores for the reporting user.
theGoldenRule: Avoid misleading hooks and clickbait that trigger 'Show less often' user feedback actions.

inSimpleTerms: Marshals rich UI frame components and layout modules into URT entry structures.
whyThisExists: Translates internal Frame representations into client-renderable interactive modules, banners, and topic carousels.
howItAffectsYourReach: Formats featured creator content into rich UI modules that capture outsized user visual attention.
theGoldenRule: Participate in structured topics and multimedia events to be eligible for rich frame marshalling.

inSimpleTerms: The core URT marshalling module, coordinating conversion of scored candidates and modules into final Thrift timeline responses.
whyThisExists: Serves as the primary serialization layer transforming internal pipeline candidates into the standard client protocol.
howItAffectsYourReach: Finalizes timeline order, entry IDs, and visual layout before transmitting the feed payload to the user.
theGoldenRule: Posts that survive all ranking and filtering stages are formatted here for direct presentation on user screens.

inSimpleTerms: Constructs navigation actions, deep links, and client intent directives for timeline entries.
whyThisExists: Ensures that tapping on posts, profiles, hashtags, or external URLs routes the user to the correct client view.
howItAffectsYourReach: Enables smooth navigation from timeline impressions to creator profile pages and conversation views.
theGoldenRule: Include clean links and hashtags that provide seamless client navigation without cluttering post readability.

inSimpleTerms: Constructs the interactive 'New Posts' / 'New Tweets' floating pill instruction for live timeline updates.
whyThisExists: Notifies active users that fresh content is available without jarringly jumping or auto-scrolling their current feed view.
howItAffectsYourReach: Drives immediate user clicks to scroll to the top of the feed, granting incoming new posts instant peak visibility.
theGoldenRule: Post breaking updates during high-activity periods to catch users clicking the 'New Posts' pill.

inSimpleTerms: Marshals individual scored post candidates into URT TimelineItem post entries with full social context and metrics.
